_comment: Pin for the public hosted-agent install: the prebuilt bare agent the extension release CI pushed to Cachix, per Nix system. Linux runs the full deploy; Apple-Silicon macOS is the bare agent (the Linux-only toolkit is Docker/Linux only). Intel macOS and Windows use Docker (Windows can also use WSL2, which is the Linux path). No x86_64-darwin: nixpkgs 26.11 dropped Intel-mac support. Refresh each path from the extension CI's printed pin on the run that actually pushed; the darwin placeholder does not resolve until the mac CI job has run.
